list.name: Mode Changes
list.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mode_change")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r.runtime_name or r.runtime_name =~ /^${runtime_name:regex}$/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({time: r._time, text: "Mode: " + r.previous_mode + " -> " + r.new_mode}))

list.name: Parameter Changes
list.query:

targets.query:
import "date"

// Nothing is written when a runtime stops, so its last rows would stand: show
// only runtimes that reported provider health in the range.
live = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "anolis_provider_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "state")
  |> keep(columns: ["runtime_name"])
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "runtime_name")
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

// The state as of the end of the range: rows are written only on change, so a
// signal unchanged since before the range is found by looking back 30d.
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 30d, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "anolis_signal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "quality")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["runtime_name"] =~ /^${runtime_name:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.runtime_name, set: live))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["provider_id"] =~ /^${provider_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device_id"] =~ /^${device_id:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    "Runtime": r.runtime_name,
    "Provider": r.provider_id,
    "Device": r.device_id,
    "Signal": r.signal_id,
    "Quality": r._value,
    "Last change": int(v: r._time) / 1000000
  }))

targets.query:
import "date"

// Nothing is written when a runtime stops, so its last rows would stand: show
// only runtimes that reported provider health in the range.
live = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "anolis_provider_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "state")
  |> keep(columns: ["runtime_name"])
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "runtime_name")
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

// Each signal's quality carried forward through the range, seeded with its
// last quality before it (rows are written only on change, looking back 30d).
seed = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 30d, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStart)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "anolis_signal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "quality")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["runtime_name"] =~ /^${runtime_name:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.runtime_name, set: live))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["provider_id"] =~ /^${provider_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device_id"] =~ /^${device_id:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: v.timeRangeStart}))

changes = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "anolis_signal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "quality")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["runtime_name"] =~ /^${runtime_name:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["provider_id"] =~ /^${provider_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device_id"] =~ /^${device_id:regex}$/)

union(tables: [seed, changes])
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> group(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field", "runtime_name", "provider_id", "device_id", "signal_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, quality: r._value, _value: 1}))
  |> group(columns: ["_time", "quality"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["quality"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "anolis_device_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "staleness_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["runtime_name"] =~ /^${runtime_name:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["provider_id"] =~ /^${provider_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device_id"] =~ /^${device_id:regex}$/)
  |> last()

panels.title: Device Staleness (latest health snapshot)
panels.description: anolis_device_health.staleness_ms: how long since the runtime last polled the device. Signal rows are written only on change, so a signal's last change is not its freshness.
